mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stat_version_device_count (product_id, version_id, device_count, stat_time) VALUES (#{productId}, #{versionId}, #{deviceCount}, #{statTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE product_id = VALUES(product_id), device_count = VALUES(device_count)
mapper.select: SELECT svdc.version_id AS versionId, fv.version AS version, svdc.stat_time AS statTime, svdc.device_count AS deviceCount FROM stat_version_device_count svdc JOIN firmware_versions fv ON fv.id = svdc.version_id AND fv.deleted = 0 WHERE svdc.product_id = #{productId} AND svdc.stat_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{hours} HOUR) ORDER BY svdc.stat_time ASC, svdc.version_id ASC

SELECT fv.product_id AS productId, dvp.version_id AS versionId, COUNT(DISTINCT dvp.device_id) AS deviceCount FROM device_version_parts dvp JOIN firmware_versions fv ON fv.id = dvp.version_id AND fv.deleted = 0 WHERE dvp.version_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fv.product_id, dvp.version_id
